messages:
Ada: Quick debrief from chaos test: during a tenant move we saw p95 jump and a ton of KV cache misses when proxy forwarded to non-resident region. Not good.
Mike: Can you share the exact proxy line and headers? Need to see whether we dropped any routing hints.
Ada: snippet: `2026-04-01T09:12:30Z proxy: route tenant=atlas src=eu-west -> dest=us-east latency=260ms kv_cache=MISS control_swap=true`
Sara: If that tenant has a residency restriction, forwarding writes may violate policy. We need a hard signal in the data plane to prevent accidental cross-border writes.
Leo: Two approaches: (A) Fail fast in non-resident regions (clear legal posture, more client errors), (B) Forward with strict encrypted audit & opt-out guardrails (lower client friction, more compliance effort).
Mike: What about a middle ground: a tenant-level flag `allow_forwarding` set via control plane. Proxies cache it; default = false. That avoids a client header change.
Ada: Agreed. Fast-path must not make a control-plane synchronous call. So proxies should maintain an in-memory tenant config cache with short TTL. On cache miss, do an async probe and either route to resident or reply with a hint.
Sara: If we rely on a cached `allow_forwarding`, legal needs: who can toggle it, retention for forwarded payloads, and KMS scoping for audit logs (EU-only storage for EU-origin forwards).
Leo: For client ergonomics we can also support an explicit consent header `X-Region-Consent: eu-west`, but default behavior stays control-plane flag first.
Mike: Operational suggestions: cache_ttl=12s, soft_forward_window=8-12s after a flip, and require 2 consecutive healthy heartbeats before finalizing ownership changes to avoid thrash.
Ada: Pseudocode for the proxy fast-path: 
```
cfg = tenant_cache.get(tenant)
if !cfg:
  probe_controlplane_async(tenant)
  respond_with_header("Retry-After: 1", "X-Fallback-Region: <resident>")
else if cfg.residency == LOCAL && !cfg.allow_forwarding && !request.has_header("X-Region-Consent"):
  return 403
else if cfg.allow_forwarding || request.has_header("X-Region-Consent"):
  forward_request(attach_audit=true)
```
Mike: Make `probe_controlplane_async` non-blocking. Also add an operator endpoint to force-refresh a tenant cache entry when running a cutover.
Sara: Compliance: all forwarded payloads must be logged to `forward_audit_destination` tenant attribute. For EU tenants that should default to `eu-kms://audit-bucket`. Audit logs must be immutable and flagged to exclude cross-region analytics pipelines.
Leo: Edge-case — streaming/chat sessions. Forwarding means shipping large KV sets which inflates latency. Option: return `503` with `X-Fallback-Region: eu-west` and let SDKs reconnect to the resident region.
Ada: We'll need a small SDK change: an `onFallbackRegion(header)` callback and an automatic reconnect flow when we see that header. Add SDK note to RFC.
Mike: Metrics to add: `handoff.forward_attempts`, `handoff.forward_success`, `handoff.forward_denied`, `handoff.audit_bytes`. SLIs: p95 during handoff < 350ms, handoff error bump < +2%.
Sara: Legal will accept a soft-forward window if: (1) forward_audit stored in tenant-scoped EU KMS, (2) product opt-in documented, (3) toggles only editable by org admins and security. I'll draft those bullets.
Ada: Operator playbook sketch: on planned eviction: (1) pre-warm control-plane cache, (2) mark tenant as `pending-swap`, (3) after N heartbeats commit, (4) if probes fail, mark `resident-only` and update routing rules, (5) emit alert when `handoff.forward_denied_rate > 5%` for 2m.
Mike: Add runtime flags: `--soft-forward-window`, `--tenant-cache-ttl`, and `--require-heartbeats=N`. Defaults will be in RFC appendix.
Leo: Also recommend proxies attach `X-Forwarded-Audit: true` to any forwarded write so downstream storage can apply routing controls.
OpsBot: control-plane: swap_event=1739998890 probes_ok=39 probes_fail=6
Ada: Ops numbers match. Mike, can you own an RFC PR with diagrams, header proto, proxy pseudocode, operator playbook, and metrics? Target EOD Monday.
Mike: Yep. I'll include a short appendix for compliance tests and SDK patch notes.
Sara: I'll add compliance test cases to the E2E matrix: simulate flip, verify audit landed in EU KMS, verify analytics pipeline excluded.
Ada: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-ups: infra-metrics ticket for new metrics, pager rule for handoff spikes, and SDK issue for reconnect callback. Closing this thread.
